user.title: Add Bluesound Player
user.description: Enter the network address of your BluOS player. The default control port is 11000.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the player (e.g. 192.168.1.42).
data_description.port: BluOS HTTP API port. Leave at 11000 unless you changed it.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Bluesound device discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to add the Bluesound player {name} ({host}) to Home Assistant?

abort.no_mac: Device did not return a MAC address — cannot uniquely identify it.

play_preset.name: Play preset
play_preset.description: Play a Bluesound preset by its numeric ID.

preset_id.name: Preset ID
preset_id.description: The numeric ID of the preset (1-99) as configured on the device.
